purpose: Review a finite set of issuer operational-incident disclosures with plausible three-session repricing relevance before opening announcement rows, titles, bodies, source values, candidate values, comparators or returns, while preventing keyword migration into terminal enforcement sources.

repository_evidence.terminal_enforcement_boundary: Administrative enforcement sources are terminal; product-quality, safety, privacy or cybersecurity penalty keyword reclassification cannot be used as a substitute for a separate issuer incident-disclosure source.
repository_evidence.domain_distinction: Issuer-disclosed recall, production interruption and cybersecurity incident states may be independent operating shocks, but only if their identity, clock, scope and severity are frozen before rows or text.

must_freeze_before_any_formula_or_direct: exact official exchange announcement source, category universe, immutable document bytes and announcement identifier
first public timestamp, trading-session availability, correction, withdrawal and revision chain
issuer, listed security, subsidiary, facility, product and geography mapping without current-state leakage
event identity, duplicate and continuation rules separating initial event, correction, progress, restart and resolution
recall units, affected-sales scope, downtime, capacity share, casualties and customer-impact severity primitives
cybersecurity incident, privacy exposure, ransomware, service outage and precautionary notice classification rules
missing, undisclosed, unknown, not-applicable and genuine-zero severity semantics
full-market announcement denominator and evidence that absence in the contracted source is not encoded as a favorable zero
complete bounded 2019-2023 partition manifest with deterministic pagination and one-shot acceptance gates
parser and source-acceptance tests that use no candidate, comparator, price or return values

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: product_recall_disclosure_recency_or_frozen_severity
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer product recall that may alter expected demand, cost or liability over the next sessions.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No accepted contract freezes initial recall identity, voluntary versus mandatory status, affected units, product/issuer mapping, corrections, availability and full 2019-2023 announcement coverage.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: production_interruption_or_safety_accident_disclosure
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: An issuer production interruption or safety accident with potential near-term capacity, cost and confidence effects.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Facility and subsidiary scope, shutdown cause, affected-capacity share, casualty fields, expected duration, restart chain and point-in-time availability are not frozen in a complete local source.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: cybersecurity_data_breach_or_service_outage_disclosure
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known cyber, privacy or digital-service disruption with potential remediation, liability and customer-trust costs.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The repository has no accepted historical contract separating confirmed incidents from precautionary notices, freezing affected entities/users, duration, correction chain and full-market disclosure coverage.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: product_quality_safety_privacy_or_cyber_regulatory_penalty
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Administrative enforcement associated with operational quality or data-security failures.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Selecting new operational keywords, penalty subtypes, severities or ages from terminal Campaign113 enforcement sources would be a forbidden text/schema rescue rather than a new incident primitive.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: incident_progress_restart_resolution_or_duration_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Evolution or resolution of a previously disclosed operating incident.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing initial versus progress versus restart, event duration, age window or resolution direction cannot precede exact admission and identity-linking of the base incident stream.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: combined_operational_incident_burden_weighted_severity_or_model
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Joint issuer exposure across recall, production/safety and cyber incident families.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Combining three unadmitted event families or choosing weights, ranks, severity proxies, filters or models would multiply hypotheses before any base source is accepted.

scientific_interpretation.safe_conclusion: Three distinct incident states remain deferred at source admission; enforcement reclassification and two premature variant families are closed before rows, text or values.

next_action: Record all six decisions in an append-only Campaign166 ledger, publish terminal accounting and continue a different finite offline prevalue domain under the next policy.
